briefdescription.para: Verify integrity of audit log hash chain.

detaileddescription.para: Verify Chain Integrity.
If hash chaining is enabled, verifies that the cryptographic chain linking audit events is intact. Detects tampering or log rotation issues.

true if chain is valid or chaining disabled; false if tampering detected
@error_contract
If chain file missing/unreadable: returns false (logs ERR_AUDIT_LOG_WRITE_FAILED)
If hash verification fails: returns false (logs ERR_AUDIT_SERVICE_DEGRADED warning)
If internal error: returns false (logs ERR_AUDIT_CLEANUP_FAILED context)
@thread_safety Thread-safe @performance O(n) where n is log file size; consider caching in production

Should be called before critical operations to detect tampering
ErrorCode::ERR_AUDIT_ROTATION_FAILED for related rotation errors
True when the operation succeeds.
Calls: std::filesystem::exists(), ifs(), std::string(), std::getline(), empty(), nlohmann::json::parse(), contains(), THEMIS_WARN().

briefdescription.para: Flush audit log to disk.

detaileddescription.para: Flush.
Flushes pending audit events to disk. If fsync is enabled in config, ensures data is durably written to storage.

void (see @error_contract below)
@error_contract
If disk full: logs ERR_AUDIT_DISK_FULL and triggers rotation/cleanup
If write permission denied: logs ERR_AUDIT_PERMISSION_DENIED
If fsync fails: logs ERR_AUDIT_SERVICE_DEGRADED (non-fatal)
All failures logged but flush continues with what it can
@thread_safety Thread-safe @performance O(pending_events); blocks until flush complete if fsync enabled

Resource Limits (Phase 2.6):
Queue Depth: Default 10,000 pending events max; older events dropped if exceeded
Event Size: Individual event JSON limited to 64 KB; larger events truncated
Memory: Bounded queue allocated on initialization; no unbounded growth
Disk I/O: Batched writes every 100 events or 100ms (configurable)
Critical for audit durability; should be called periodically
ErrorCode for diagnostics
Calls: lock().
